name: multi-agent-role-work
description: Cost-aware formal multi-role delivery with executable verification, explicit routing, and user approval without lifecycle hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Risk-adaptive product, engineering, and testing workflow.
interface.longDescription: Start with an actionable Team Development request in any project; no workflow command knowledge is required. The orchestrator opens discovery rather than coding, performs evidence-backed requirement and risk triage, selects the lowest safe micro, quick, standard, or strict flow, persists each delegated role attempt and its content-addressed outputs, atomically records complete role-gate reviews and strict verification bundles, executes checks against one immutable delivery candidate, supports explicit impact-scoped change control, requires profile-appropriate final-user-journey checks and final user approval, and preserves recoverable checksummed state with runtime provenance and deterministic lifecycle recovery.
capabilities: Persisted role work items and leases
